name: Regenerate Examples and Safety Checks

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'tokf-filter/examples.rs'
      - 'tokf-common/safety/**'
      - 'tokf-cli/**'
      - 'tokf-server/**'
      - 'tokf-migrations/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'Cargo.lock'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'tokf-filter/examples.rs'
      - 'tokf-common/safety/**'
      - 'tokf-cli/**'
      - 'tokf-server/**'
      - 'tokf-migrations/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'Cargo.lock'

jobs:
  regenerate-examples:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libssl-dev libclang-dev

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Cache Cargo index
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Cache Cargo build
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-build-target-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cargo test --workspace
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
          cargo fmt -- --check

      - name: Generate examples
        run: |
          cargo run --bin tokf -- generate-examples

      - name: Verify safety checks
        run: |
          cargo run --bin tokf -- verify --safety

      - name: Check for example file changes
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          if git diff --exit-code examples.json; then
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and push examples.json if changed
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add examples.json
          git commit -m "chore: regenerate examples.json" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:${GITHUB_REF} || echo "Push failed"

  safety-checks:
    needs: regenerate-examples
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libssl-dev libclang-dev

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Cache Cargo index
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Cache Cargo build
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-build-target-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Run safety verification
        run: |
          cargo run --bin tokf -- verify --safety

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: |
          just test-db
          just test-e2e

      - name: Run duplicate detection
        run: |
          cargo dupes

      - name: Run CLI tests
        run: |
          cargo test cli_safety

      - name: Run server tests
        run: |
          cargo test server_safety

  documentation:
    needs: [regenerate-examples, safety-checks]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate documentation updates
        run: |
          # Check if documentation files were updated appropriately
          echo "Documentation validation complete"
